installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
apt-get update
apt-get install -y curl git

cd /mnt/server

if [ "${USER_UPLOAD}" == "false" ] || [ "${USER_UPLOAD}" == "0" ]; then
    if [ ! -z "${GIT_REPO}" ]; then
        if [ -d ".git" ]; then
            git pull
        else
            git clone ${GIT_REPO} .
        fi
    fi
fi

echo "Installation complete!"
